title: A contraction-ray integral cancels polynomial forcing in one common global Lyapunov certificate

statement.quantifiers: Nonnegative-orthant system udot=1-u, zdot=eta-Gamma(u)z^2 with polynomial Gamma>=1 and Gamma(1)=eta; in the constructed reaction family degreeGamma<=6.
statement.assertion: Q(u)=integral_0^1 [Gamma(1+s(u-1))-eta]^2/s ds is a nonnegative rational polynomial, dotQ=-(Gamma(u)-eta)^2; V=||u-1||^2+(z-1)^2+Q has dotV<=-(z-1)^2-2||u-1||^2.
assumptions: Polynomial numerator vanishes quadratically at s0; integral is coefficientwise exact, not a numerical improper-integral approximation.
Gamma>=1 on the admitted orthant and eta=Gamma(1).
ODE positivity/global existence follows with coercivity and boundary directions; stochastic conservativity is a separate question.

inputs: Contracting controller flow and polynomial positive damping.
outputs: Coercive parameter-independent polynomial GAS certificate, degree<=12 in the stated construction.
interface.precision: Exact rational polynomial identities; finite checks reported but not supplied.
costs: Coefficient expansion can be large; the universal DPRM reaction instance is not concretely listed.
No physical witness acquisition or stochastic lifetime decision from the ODE certificate.

proof_mechanism: Differentiate Q along the radial contraction to obtain the endpoint square cancellation.
The remaining coefficient is positive on the orthant; coercivity plus strict derivative bounds gives global attraction of the unique equilibrium.
obstructions: Deterministic global Lyapunov stability does not certify stochastic nonexplosion.
Negative deterministic monomial damping can coexist with a positive count-level factorial drift state.

potential_uses.target: Stable polynomial systems with hidden stochastic phase changes
potential_uses.transfer_gate: Separate deterministic damping from factorial count coefficients, then use a common exact Lyapunov correction instead of parameter-dependent stability assertions.

review.source_reported: Source claims complete written arguments and scoped finite checks; independent audit receipts or executable replay packages not supplied; no independent ingestion proof reconstruction, scientific replay, external correctness or priority clearance.
